title: Business Administration: Marketing Specialized Area
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Business Administration: Marketing Specialized Area - Certificate of Achievement - CE1113
outcomes: Use technology to analyze marketing strategy and decisions and to enhance business.
Have an understanding of legal practices relating to business practices, including intellectual properties rights.
Analyze the business elements that comprise the logistics function.
Develop and apply principles of moral judgment and ethical behavior to business situations.
Anticipate and pose problems relative to understanding and supervising personnel. Identify and analyze human relations techniques appropriate to a managerial role.
Explain and develop the marketing mix, including an analysis of the marketing mix variables—product, place, price, and promotion.

notes: The 'Units: 15.00' printed under the 'Required Courses' heading covers the whole requirement list including both 'Select one of the following' choices, so it is recorded as the program total (also printed as 'Total : 15.00') rather than as the stated total of the first block.

BUS-10 and BUS-10H are listed under 'Select one of the following' as an honors pair; recorded as one entry with BUS-10H as its alternative. Both are marked '( Historical )' in the catalog, which a reviewer may want to check.

The text also carries a line 'Industry Marketing - Certificate of Achievement - CE879' with no requirements of its own; it appears to be a former or related program title and was not read as a separate section.
The sixth outcome is printed as a single line containing two sentences ('Anticipate and pose problems... Identify and analyze human relations techniques...'); recorded as one outcome as printed.
Catalog codes are printed with hyphens (e.g., MKT-25); they match the closed-list codes (e.g., MKT 25).
